description:
You are Maya Johansson, Senior Systems Analyst at Cascade Distribution Group. A new Warehouse Management System (WMS), 'StockPulse', is being deployed. You must create a comprehensive End-User Manual for the warehouse staff based on the system specifications provided in /home/ga/Documents/system_specs.json. 

Using Apache OpenOffice Writer, create a professional manual that includes:
1. A Title Page with the document metadata.
2. An auto-generated Table of Contents.
3. At least 7 main sections (Heading 1) and 10 subsections (Heading 2) covering the required topics in the specs.
4. Formatted tables for System Requirements, Keyboard Shortcuts, and Error Codes.
5. Step-by-step procedures for the workflows (Receiving, Picking, etc.).
6. A Footer with page numbers.

Save the final document as /home/ga/Documents/StockPulse_WMS_User_Manual.odt. The document must be substantial (at least 40 paragraphs) and professionally formatted using Styles, NOT direct formatting.
